# `bin/skills/` — the skill shelves and their discovery

**Generated by `bin/gates/inventory.sh`. Do not hand-edit; run `bin/gates/inventory.sh` and
commit the result.** `bin/gates/inventory.sh --check` fails when this file and the
part of the shelf it describes disagree, so the index cannot rot the way the hand-written
one did.

**Read the columns.** `verdict` is measured, not judged: `tested` = a test
exercises it · `wired` = a skill, doc or gate names it · `internal` = only other
doors call it · `orphan` = nothing outside `bin/` names it · `provenance` = a
vendored `fm-*` script kept byte-comparable to upstream on purpose.
`disposition` says what happens to it: `keep`, `migrate → src/…` where the
Python runtime already has the module, `retire` for orphans, `provenance`.
